tagline.zh: 從一張血液抹片到一通溶血的電話
tagline.en: From one blood film to the haemolysis call

desc.zh: 讀整組報告、補問會改變路徑的病史、接檢驗室電話、寫交班。數字是平均，抹片是真相。
desc.en: Read the whole panel, ask the history that changes the pathway, take the lab calls, write the handover. Numbers are averages; the film is the truth.

desc.zh: 分析儀、推片、離心機、危急值電話都是你的。檢體有問題還是病人有問題，你第一個知道。
desc.en: The analyser, the smears, the centrifuge and the critical-value calls are yours. Sample problem or patient problem: you know first.

about.zh: 血液科主治，看報告之前一定先看抹片。口袋裡有一個放大鏡，用了二十年。
about.en: Haematologist who looks at the film before she reads the numbers. Carries a twenty-year-old loupe in her pocket.

about.zh: 血液檢驗室的醫檢師。推片角度三十度，從不失手。打危急值電話的時候，會等你複誦完才掛。
about.en: The haematology lab's scientist. Spreads every film at thirty degrees and never misses. On a critical-value call she waits until you have read it back.

about.zh: 61 歲退休郵差，三個月來爬樓梯會喘，以為是老了。腰痛常吃止痛藥。沒有看到流血，所以沒說。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 61-year-old retired postman, breathless on stairs for three months and sure it was just age. Takes painkillers for his back. Saw no bleeding, so said nothing. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 記得先生每一件事，包括馬桶裡的顏色。只是沒有人問過她。
about.en: Remembers everything about her husband, including the colour in the toilet bowl. Nobody had asked her.

about.zh: 36 歲廚師，這兩週很累、眼白變黃。上週因為過敏開始吃一種新藥。第一管血被檢驗室標示溶血。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 36-year-old chef, exhausted for two weeks, whites of the eyes turning yellow. Started a new drug for an allergy last week. His first blood tube was flagged haemolysed by the lab. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 28 歲，體檢發現紅血球很小但不缺鐵。媽媽和哥哥都「被說過紅血球很小」。正在計畫懷孕。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 28-year-old whose health check found very small red cells without iron deficiency. Her mother and brother were both 'told their red cells were small'. Planning a pregnancy. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 病房護理師。尿壺的顏色和量，她都會寫在交班單上。
about.en: Ward nurse. The colour and the volume in the urine bottle both go on her handover sheet.

plain.zh: 血液裡載氧的紅血球或血紅素不夠。它是結果，不是診斷；問題永遠是「為什麼」。
plain.en: Too few oxygen-carrying red cells or too little haemoglobin. It is a finding, not a diagnosis; the question is always 'why'.

plain.zh: 紅血球裡載氧的蛋白。報告上第一個數字，但單獨一個數字不會告訴你原因。
plain.en: The oxygen-carrying protein in red cells. The first number on the report, and on its own it never tells you the cause.

plain.zh: 紅血球比正常小。最常見是缺鐵，但地中海型貧血帶因也會，兩者的處理完全不同。
plain.en: Red cells smaller than normal. Usually iron deficiency, but thalassaemia trait does it too, and the two are managed quite differently.

plain.zh: 身體儲存鐵的指標。很低代表鐵真的用完了；一個鐵用完的成年男性，一定要問「血從哪裡流掉」。
plain.en: The marker of the body's iron stores. Very low means the iron is truly gone, and an adult man with empty stores must be asked 'where is the blood going'.

plain.zh: 又黑又黏的大便，代表上消化道在慢慢流血。病人常常不覺得那是「流血」。
plain.en: Black, sticky stool from slow bleeding high in the gut. Patients often do not think of it as 'bleeding'.

plain.zh: 一滴血推成薄薄一層，染色後在顯微鏡下看每一顆細胞的形狀。分析儀給平均，抹片給真相。
plain.en: A drop of blood spread into a thin layer, stained and examined cell by cell under the microscope. The analyser gives averages; the film gives the truth.

plain.zh: 紅血球在身體裡被提早破壞。眼白變黃、尿變深、網狀球升高，血紅素一直掉。
plain.en: Red cells being destroyed early inside the body. Yellow eyes, dark urine, rising reticulocytes and a haemoglobin that keeps falling.

plain.zh: 抽血時紅血球在試管裡被弄破，血清變紅，有些數值會不準。是檢體的問題，但不代表病人沒有問題。
plain.en: Red cells broken inside the tube during collection, turning the serum red and spoiling some values. A sample problem, which does not mean the patient has none.

plain.zh: 剛出廠的年輕紅血球。數量升高代表骨髓在拚命補貨，通常是因為外面有血在流失或被破壞。
plain.en: Freshly made young red cells. A rise means the marrow is working overtime, usually because blood is being lost or destroyed elsewhere.

plain.zh: 眼白和皮膚變黃。紅血球被破壞時放出的膽色素太多，肝臟來不及處理。
plain.en: Yellow eyes and skin. Too much bile pigment released from destroyed red cells for the liver to keep up with.

plain.zh: 看紅血球表面有沒有黏著抗體的檢驗。陽性提示免疫性溶血，但要和用藥史一起看。
plain.en: A test for antibodies stuck to the surface of red cells. A positive suggests immune haemolysis, but it is read together with the drug history.

plain.zh: 遺傳到一個製造血紅素的基因變化，紅血球小但人通常很健康。重要的是伴侶也帶因時對下一代的影響。
plain.en: An inherited change in one haemoglobin gene: small red cells in a usually healthy person. What matters is the next generation if the partner carries it too.

plain.zh: 把檢驗結果、遺傳機率和選項講清楚，讓病人自己決定，不替她決定。
plain.en: Explaining the results, the inheritance odds and the options clearly, so the patient decides for herself; nobody decides for her.

plain.zh: 從後上髂棘（屁股上方的骨頭）取一點骨髓看造血工廠。定位要準，過程由專業團隊執行。
plain.en: Taking a sample of marrow from the back of the pelvis to look at the blood factory. The landmark must be exact; the procedure itself is done by the trained team.

plain.zh: 檢驗室看到可能危及生命的數字，直接打電話給醫師，對方複誦確認並記錄時間。
plain.en: A result that could threaten life now. The lab phones the doctor directly; the doctor reads it back and records the time.

text.zh: 幾十秒內算出血紅素、紅血球大小、白血球、血小板。它很快、很準，但給的是平均值，看不到形狀。它會打旗標請你去看抹片。
text.en: Haemoglobin, red-cell size, white cells and platelets in under a minute. Fast and accurate, but it reports averages and cannot see shape. When unsure it raises a flag asking you to look at the film.

text.zh: 低倍找分布，高倍看單顆細胞。缺鐵的紅血球中間很白、像鉛筆；溶血的抹片上有球形細胞和碎片。
text.en: Low power for distribution, high power for single cells. Iron-deficient cells are pale-centred and pencil-shaped; a haemolysis film shows spherocytes and fragments.

text.zh: 把血分成血球和血清。配平要對，蓋子要鎖。溶血檢體離心後血清是紅的，一眼就看得出來。
text.en: Separates cells from serum. Balance the tubes, lock the lid. After spinning, a haemolysed sample shows red serum that you can spot across the room.

text.zh: 消毒、鋪單、抽吸針、切片針、玻片、固定液。定位點是後上髂棘。這裡只教定位，不教穿刺。
text.en: Antiseptic, drapes, aspiration needle, trephine needle, slides, fixative. The landmark is the posterior superior iliac spine. Here we teach landmarking only, never the needle.

text.zh: 溶血的病人心跳變快是在代償。代償不代表器官灌流足夠；心悸、胸悶、尿量減少出現時，監視器上的數字已經不夠用了。
text.en: A haemolysing patient's fast pulse is compensation. Compensation does not guarantee organ perfusion; once palpitations, chest tightness and falling urine appear, the monitor numbers are no longer enough.

text.zh: 小魏推的，三十度，羽毛狀邊緣。高倍下：中間很白的小紅血球、幾顆鉛筆細胞。這張片子比任何一個數字更早告訴你「缺鐵」。
text.en: Spread by Wei at thirty degrees with a feathered edge. High power: small pale-centred red cells and a few pencil cells. This slide said 'iron deficiency' before any number did.

name.zh: 數字是平均，抹片是真相
name.en: Numbers are averages; the film is the truth

text.zh: 兩群大小不同的紅血球平均起來可以「正常」。分析儀看不到這件事，抹片看得到。所以蔡主治先看片子，再看報告。
text.en: Two populations of differently sized red cells can average out to 'normal'. The analyser cannot see that; the film can. That is why Dr Tsai looks at the slide before the report.

text.zh: 檢驗室說「溶血」，可能是試管裡的事，也可能是病人身體裡的事，也可能兩個都是。重抽一管，同時看病人的眼白。
text.en: When the lab says 'haemolysed', it may be the tube, the patient, or both. Redraw a tube, and at the same time look at the patient's eyes.

note.en: Took over Mr Chung in bed 3

guide.en: Hear the handover at the board

lines.zh: （擴音）3 床阿忠伯，61 歲，三個月爬樓梯會喘，昨晚因為血紅素低入院。血壓穩定。沒有看到流血。
lines.en: (On speaker) Bed 3, Mr Chung, 61, breathless on stairs for three months, admitted last night with a low haemoglobin. Pressure stable. No bleeding seen.

lines.zh: 「沒有看到流血」。記住這句話，等一下會變成另一句。整組報告先讀，不要只讀第一個數字。
lines.en: 'No bleeding seen.' Remember that sentence; it will become a different one shortly. Read the whole panel, not just the first number.

guide.en: Read the panel with Dr Tsai

lines.zh: 血紅素低、紅血球小、鐵蛋白非常低。缺鐵性貧血。
lines.en: Low haemoglobin, small red cells, very low ferritin. Iron-deficiency anaemia.

lines.zh: 對，然後呢？缺鐵是結果。一個 61 歲男性把鐵用完了，問題是什麼？
lines.en: Yes, and? Iron deficiency is a finding. A 61-year-old man has emptied his iron stores; what is the question?

post.zh: 對。追查來源。血從哪裡流掉，比補鐵更重要。
post.en: Right. Trace the source. Where the blood is going matters more than replacing the iron.

guide.en: Sort the orders at the station

lines.zh: 鐵劑的醫囑單在螢幕上等你簽。旁邊是他的藥單：止痛藥，每天。
lines.en: The iron order waits on the screen for your signature. Next to it, his drug list: painkillers, daily.

q.zh: 缺鐵的 61 歲男性，第一張醫囑除了鐵劑還有什麼？
q.en: Iron deficiency in a 61-year-old man. Besides iron, what goes on the first order?

options.zh: 停止痛藥、問黑便、安排消化道來源檢查
options.en: Stop the painkillers, ask about black stools, arrange gut investigations

why.zh: 止痛藥會讓胃慢慢流血。補鐵只是把水加進漏水的桶子。
why.en: Painkillers make the stomach bleed slowly. Replacing iron alone is pouring water into a leaking bucket.

options.zh: 先補鐵，三個月後看血紅素
options.en: Iron first; check the haemoglobin in three months

why.zh: 三個月後血紅素可能真的上來了，而他的潰瘍或腫瘤還在。
why.en: In three months the haemoglobin may indeed be up, and his ulcer or tumour still there.

options.zh: 輸血讓他舒服一點就好

why.zh: 他血壓穩定、慢性貧血。輸血不回答任何問題。
why.en: He is stable with a chronic anaemia. A transfusion answers no question.

guide.en: Spread the film in the lab

lines.zh: 分析儀打了旗標，請我們看抹片。每一份貧血我都推一張。推片玻片三十度，一氣呵成，羽毛狀邊緣。
lines.en: The analyser flagged it and asked for a film. I spread one for every anaemia. Spreader at thirty degrees, one smooth stroke, feathered edge.

post.zh: 好片子。太厚看不到細胞，太薄細胞會變形。染好之後蔡主治會自己來看。
post.en: A good film. Too thick and you cannot see cells; too thin and they distort. Once stained, Dr Tsai will come and look herself.

note.en: Asked, and found Mr Chung's melaena

guide.en: See Mr Chung at bed 3

lines.zh: 醫師，我送了三十年信，一天走兩萬步。現在爬兩層樓就喘，我以為是老了。
lines.en: Doctor, thirty years delivering post, twenty thousand steps a day. Now two flights of stairs leave me breathless. I thought it was age.

lines.zh: 阿忠伯，大便的顏色最近有沒有變黑、變黏？
lines.en: Mr Chung, has your stool been black or sticky lately?

lines.zh: ……黑黑的算嗎？我以為是吃豬血糕。
lines.en: ...Does blackish count? I thought it was the pig's blood cake.

lines.zh: 三個月了啦，我每次都說要看醫生。沒有人問我，我就不好意思講。
lines.en: Three months, and I kept saying see a doctor. Nobody asked me, so I did not like to say.

lines.zh: 聽到了嗎？「沒有看到流血」變成了「黑便三個月」。差別只是一個問題。
lines.en: Did you hear that? 'No bleeding seen' just became 'melaena for three months'. The difference was one question.

guide.zh: 到顯微鏡看阿忠伯的抹片
guide.en: Look at Mr Chung's film under the microscope

lines.zh: 先看片子，再看報告。低倍找分布，高倍看單顆。你看到什麼？
lines.en: Film first, report second. Low power for distribution, high power for single cells. What do you see?

lines.zh: 紅血球很小、中間很白，有幾顆像鉛筆。
lines.en: Small red cells, pale centres, a few shaped like pencils.

lines.zh: 這張片子比鐵蛋白更早告訴你缺鐵。帶著它，以後每個小球性貧血都先想它。
lines.en: This slide said iron deficiency before the ferritin did. Keep it; every microcytic anaemia from now on, think of it first.

guide.en: Write Mr Chung's admission assessment

lines.zh: 你寫下：疲倦與喘的時間線、止痛藥、黑便三個月、整組血液資料、抹片所見、來源檢查的計畫。「沒有看到流血」這句話被劃掉了。
lines.en: You write: the timeline of fatigue and breathlessness, the painkillers, three months of melaena, the whole blood panel, the film findings, the plan to find the source. 'No bleeding seen' has been crossed out.

lines.zh: （經過）劃掉的那句話留著，不要刪。三個月後你會想看到自己怎麼學會問的。
lines.en: (Passing) Keep the crossed-out sentence; do not delete it. In three months you will want to see how you learned to ask.

guide.zh: 接檢驗室電話，到離心機旁
guide.en: Take the lab call, go to the centrifuge

sub.zh: 9 床小杜第一管血溶血，但血紅素偏低
sub.en: Bed 9, Mr Tu: first tube haemolysed, but haemoglobin low

lines.zh: 小魏。9 床小杜第一管血清是紅的，溶血檢體，部分數值不能報。血紅素偏低，還不到危急值，但你應該知道。
lines.en: Wei. Bed 9, Mr Tu: the first tube spun down with red serum, a haemolysed sample, some values cannot be reported. His haemoglobin is low, not a critical value yet, but I thought you should know.

lines.zh: 謝謝。我去看他，順便重抽。
lines.en: Thanks. I will see him and redraw.

lines.zh: 等等。檢驗室說「溶血」是試管裡的事。你去看病人的眼白，那是身體裡的事。兩個可以同時成立。
lines.en: Wait. When the lab says 'haemolysed', that is inside the tube. Go and look at the patient's eyes; that is inside the body. Both can be true at once.

post.zh: 醫師，我眼睛黃黃的，尿也變深，是不是肝不好？我是廚師，我吃得很乾淨。
post.en: Doctor, my eyes are yellow and my urine is dark. Is it my liver? I am a chef, I eat clean.

post.zh: 可能不是肝，是紅血球。小杜，你上週開始吃的新藥，叫什麼？
post.en: Perhaps not the liver, but the red cells. Mr Tu, that new drug you started last week, what is it called?

guide.en: Redraw a tube, without haemolysing it

lines.zh: 重抽的時候順序對了，我才有東西可以報。排一次給我看。
lines.en: If the redraw is done right, I have something to report. Show me the sequence.

q.zh: 把重抽血液檢體的步驟排對
q.en: Put the redraw steps in order

steps.zh: 床邊核對雙識別並貼標籤
steps.en: Two identifiers at the bedside, label

steps.zh: 選對試管，依正確順序採血
steps.en: Right tubes, correct order of draw

steps.zh: 註明採檢時間，立即送檢
steps.en: Note the time, send at once

steps.zh: 通知檢驗室與前一管對照
steps.en: Tell the lab to compare with tube one

post.zh: 對。針太細、抽太用力、搖太兇，都會在試管裡溶血。這次你抽的血清是黃的。病人的那一半，報告下午出來。
post.en: Right. A narrow needle, hard suction or rough shaking all haemolyse the tube. Your redraw spun down yellow. The patient's half of the story comes this afternoon.

guide.en: Go over the redraw results with Dr Tsai

lines.zh: 重抽回來：血紅素比早上更低，網狀球升高，間接膽紅素升高。方向一致。這不是試管，是身體。
lines.en: The redraw is back: haemoglobin lower than this morning, reticulocytes up, indirect bilirubin up. All pointing the same way. This is not the tube; it is the body.

lines.zh: 直接抗球蛋白試驗呢？
lines.en: And the direct antiglobulin test?

lines.zh: 陽性。加上上週的新藥。免疫線索要和用藥史一起看，藥先停，專科評估。
lines.en: Positive. Plus last week's new drug. An immune clue is read with the drug history: stop the drug, specialist review.

guide.zh: 到 PACS 看小杜的腹部影像
guide.en: Review Mr Tu's abdominal imaging on PACS

lines.zh: 急診幫他做了腹部影像。先核對姓名日期。然後想：這張片要回答什麼？
lines.en: The ER did abdominal imaging. Name and date first. Then think: what is this study meant to answer?

question.zh: 黃疸加血紅素下降的病人，腹部影像要幫你看什麼？
question.en: Jaundice with a falling haemoglobin: what should the abdominal imaging show you?

answer.zh: 脾臟有沒有腫大、膽囊有沒有結石、膽管有沒有擴張。它幫你排除阻塞性黃疸、看溶血的痕跡，但溶血的診斷靠網狀球、膽紅素和抹片，不靠影像。
answer.en: Whether the spleen is enlarged, whether there are gallstones, whether the bile duct is dilated. It excludes obstructive jaundice and shows the footprints of haemolysis, but haemolysis itself is diagnosed by reticulocytes, bilirubin and the film, not by the image.

post.zh: 脾臟稍大，膽管不寬。影像和檢驗說同一個故事。下午盯著他的心跳和尿量。
post.en: Spleen slightly enlarged, duct not dilated. Image and labs tell the same story. This afternoon, watch his pulse and his urine output.

guide.en: Call Ms Lin into the room

lines.zh: 醫師，體檢說我紅血球很小，叫我補鐵。可是我媽和我哥都被說過一樣的話，他們都很健康。
lines.en: Doctor, the health check said my red cells are small and told me to take iron. But my mum and my brother were told the same thing, and they are both healthy.

lines.zh: 妳的鐵蛋白不低，也沒有發炎。紅血球小但不缺鐵，家族裡又有一樣的。這是線索。
lines.en: Your ferritin is not low and there is no inflammation. Small cells without iron deficiency, and the same thing in the family. That is a clue.

lines.zh: 小球性不只有缺鐵一種。補鐵給一個不缺鐵的人，是在治療一個數字。
lines.en: Microcytic does not only mean iron deficiency. Giving iron to someone who is not short of it treats a number.

post.zh: 其實我正在計畫懷孕。這個會不會……影響小孩？我先生需要檢查嗎？
post.en: Actually, I am planning a pregnancy. Could this... affect the baby? Does my husband need testing?

post.zh: 問得好。地中海型貧血帶因本身對妳很安全。關鍵是伴侶，所以我們安排遺傳諮詢，把選項講清楚，決定權在妳。
post.en: A good question. Thalassaemia trait is safe for you. The key is your partner, so we arrange genetic counselling, lay out the options clearly, and the decision stays yours.

guide.zh: 寫門診紀錄與諮詢轉介
guide.en: Write the clinic note and the counselling referral

lines.zh: 你寫下：指數與鐵儲存、家族史、初步血紅素分析的限制、病人想討論的生育問題、遺傳諮詢的轉介。最後一行：不補鐵。
lines.en: You write: indices and iron stores, family history, the limits of the initial haemoglobin analysis, the reproductive questions she wants discussed, the counselling referral. Last line: no iron.

guide.zh: 到器械車前準備骨髓檢查
guide.en: Prepare the marrow examination at the tray

lines.zh: 7 床下午要做骨髓檢查，由我執行。你負責定位：後上髂棘。定位準，病人痛得少。
lines.en: Bed 7 has a bone marrow examination this afternoon; I will perform it. Your job is the landmark: the posterior superior iliac spine. An exact landmark means less pain.

lines.zh: 玻片和固定液我準備好了。抹片在床邊就要推，骨髓片不能等。
lines.en: Slides and fixative are ready. Marrow films are spread at the bedside; they cannot wait.

post.zh: 好。側躺、找髂嵴、往後往內到後上髂棘，標記。穿刺的部分是我的。
post.en: Good. Lateral position, find the iliac crest, back and in to the posterior superior iliac spine, mark it. The needle part is mine.

guide.en: Take the call, run to bed 9

sub.zh: 小杜心悸、胸悶，尿量變少
sub.en: Mr Tu: palpitations, chest tightness, less urine

lines.zh: 小雲。9 床小杜說心悸、胸口悶，這三個小時尿量很少，顏色像可樂。心跳一直快。
lines.en: Yun. Bed 9, Mr Tu, says palpitations and chest tightness; very little urine these three hours, cola-coloured. Pulse persistently fast.

lines.zh: 監視器上心跳很快。小杜額頭都是汗，說話有點喘。
lines.en: The monitor shows a racing pulse. Mr Tu's forehead is wet and he is slightly breathless.

options.zh: 叫師傅、心電圖、評估循環與腎功能、依醫囑備血
options.en: Call the mentor, ECG, assess circulation and kidneys, blood per orders

why.zh: 代償性心跳快不保證器官灌流。胸悶加尿量減少，循環和腎臟都要升級評估。
why.en: A compensatory tachycardia does not guarantee perfusion. Chest tightness with falling urine means circulation and kidneys both need escalation.

options.zh: 心跳快是貧血正常的，觀察
options.en: A fast pulse is normal in anaemia; observe

why.zh: 「正常的代償」出現胸悶和少尿，就不再正常。
why.en: 'Normal compensation' stops being normal once chest tightness and oliguria appear.

options.en: Encourage fluids and the urine will come

why.zh: 可樂色的尿是溶血的血紅素在通過腎臟。這不是喝水的問題。
why.en: Cola-coloured urine is haemoglobin from haemolysis passing through the kidneys. This is not a hydration problem.

guide.en: Judge the urgency with the mentor

lines.zh: （趕到）早上他只是黃。現在他在告訴你器官撐不住了。急迫性由什麼決定？
lines.en: (Arriving) This morning he was merely yellow. Now he is telling you his organs are struggling. What decides the urgency?

post.zh: 對。症狀決定急迫性，不是數字。輸血科和腎臟科現在就要知道他。
post.en: Right. Symptoms decide urgency, not numbers. Transfusion and renal need to know about him now.

post.zh: 醫師……我早上還在想晚上要不要回去開店。
post.en: Doctor... this morning I was still wondering whether to open the restaurant tonight.

post.zh: 今晚店先休息。你的紅血球需要我們全部的人。
post.en: The restaurant rests tonight. Your red cells need all of us.

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 3 床阿忠伯：缺鐵加黑便三個月，止痛藥已停，消化內科排了內視鏡。
lines.en: Bed 3, Mr Chung: iron deficiency with three months of melaena, painkillers stopped, GI have booked the endoscopy.

lines.zh: 9 床小杜：免疫性溶血疑似藥物引起，藥已停，循環與腎功能升級監測。
lines.en: Bed 9, Mr Tu: probable drug-induced immune haemolysis, drug stopped, circulation and kidneys under escalated monitoring.

lines.zh: 阿忠伯那條線你早上就拉對了。來源檢查已經在跑，夜班不用從頭想。
lines.en: You drew Mr Chung's line correctly this morning. The source work-up is already running; the night team need not start from scratch.

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 3 床阿忠伯：缺鐵，黑便三個月。9 床小杜：免疫性溶血疑似藥物引起，藥已停，循環與腎功能升級監測。
lines.en: Bed 3, Mr Chung: iron deficiency, three months of melaena. Bed 9, Mr Tu: probable drug-induced immune haemolysis, drug stopped, circulation and kidneys under escalated monitoring.

lines.zh: 阿忠伯早上你只開了鐵劑。黑便是我在床邊問出來的，止痛藥到中午才停，內視鏡現在才排。桶子漏了半天，你在加水。
lines.en: For Mr Chung you ordered only iron this morning. The melaena came out at the bedside when I asked, the painkillers stopped at noon, the endoscopy is only being booked now. Half a day of a leaking bucket while you poured water in.

lines.zh: 記住了。缺鐵是結果，來源才是問題。
lines.en: Noted. Iron deficiency is the finding; the source is the question.

guide.en: End-of-day analyser QC

lines.zh: 品管液跑過、旗標清完、離心機清潔、今天的抹片歸檔。小杜那兩管我放在一起，紅的和黃的，當教材。
lines.en: Controls run, flags cleared, centrifuge cleaned, today's films filed. Mr Tu's two tubes I keep side by side, the red and the yellow, for teaching.

lines.zh: 病人還是檢體。
lines.en: Patient or sample.

lines.zh: 今天的答案是：都是。
lines.en: Today's answer: both.

guide.en: The mentor's debrief

lines.zh: 今天三個人，三張片子。阿忠伯的鉛筆細胞、小杜的球形細胞、林小姐那張看起來「正常」的小細胞。
lines.en: Three people, three films today. Mr Chung's pencil cells, Mr Tu's spherocytes, Ms Lin's small cells that looked 'normal'.

lines.zh: 分析儀給你平均，抹片給你真相，病人給你原因。順序不要反。
lines.en: The analyser gives you averages, the film gives you the truth, the patient gives you the cause. Never reverse the order.

lines.zh: 師傅，妳的放大鏡借我一天。
lines.en: Dr Tsai, lend me your loupe for a day.

lines.zh: 自己買一個。用二十年。
lines.en: Buy your own. Use it for twenty years.

note.en: Night: Mr Chung dizzy on standing

guide.en: Take the call, back to bed 3

sub.zh: 阿忠伯起身上廁所差點昏倒
sub.en: Mr Chung nearly fainted getting up to the toilet

lines.zh: 小雲。3 床阿忠伯剛剛起來上廁所差點昏倒，躺回去就好了。又解了一次黑便，量比早上多。心跳比傍晚快。
lines.en: Yun. Bed 3, Mr Chung, nearly fainted getting up to the toilet; fine once lying down. Passed another black stool, more than this morning. Pulse faster than this evening.

lines.zh: 這不是慢性貧血了，是急性出血的警訊。平躺、靜脈通路、血紅素與循環重評、依醫囑備血，我現在通知消化內科和蔡主治。
lines.en: This is no longer chronic anaemia; it is a warning of acute bleeding. Lie flat, IV access, repeat haemoglobin and circulation, blood per orders, and I am calling GI and Dr Tsai now.

lines.zh: 醫師，我以為慢慢來就好……
lines.en: Doctor, I thought we had time...

lines.zh: 阿忠伯，白天是慢慢來，晚上是現在。這就是為什麼我們要找來源。
lines.en: Mr Chung, in the daytime it was slowly; tonight it is now. This is exactly why we look for the source.

sub.zh: 分析儀給平均，抹片給真相，病人給原因
sub.en: Averages from the analyser, truth from the film, the cause from the patient
